trans_machine_crank.name: Wood crank / metal rod / piston
trans_machine_crank.description: Rotation constrains a metal connecting rod; the rod translates a wooden piston. Contact can deliver a ball. Unpin the rod: turning alone no longer guarantees delivery.
trans_machine_crank.qfep_connection: A constraint is a rule with material consequences. Visible motion does not guarantee an outcome; coupling, contact and clearance make success conditional.

trans_machine_lever.name: Working lever / two effort arms
trans_machine_lever.description: Pull the same loaded beam at two distances from its pivot. A real hinge and attached rigid load determine what lifts.

trans_machine_suspended.name: Rope / suspended construction cube
trans_machine_suspended.description: Pull and release the cube with a bounded force grip. Four pinned links keep it attached; gravity, contact and the slot determine its passage.
